stories.headline: iPhone Duo internal display break: Are iPhone Duo displays too fragile? Users report alarming cracks near hinge
stories.summary: Users have begun reporting instances of broken inner displays in the new iPhone Duo model. Cracks are appearing near the hinge, causing concern about the device's durability. Some owners experienced damage after minimal use, with one individual reporting a crack after just six hours. Apple is currently analyzing reported cases to determine whether there is a manufacturing issue involved.

stories.headline: US Markets Today: Dow ends 600 pts lower as AI doubts persist ahead of Fed meet
stories.summary: US stocks ended lower after a turbulent week as fresh doubts over the AI trade weighed on sentiment. The Dow fell 1.25%, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq also declined. Investors turned their focus to major earnings from Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon, along with next week’s Federal Reserve meeting.

stories.headline: Tata Motors CV posts Rs 2,138 crore Q2 profit
stories.summary: Tata Motors Ltd achieved a standalone net profit of ₹2,138 crore for the September quarter, reversing last year's loss. Revenue from operations rose significantly to ₹23,930 crore, up 42% from the previous year. Improved demand was driven by higher fleet utilization and industrial activity, according to managing director Girish Wagh. Consolidated profit also increased to ₹1,257 crore, aided by a drop in mark-to-market losses.

stories.headline: US data centre spending seen more than doubling to $2.1 trillion by 2028, estimates BoFA
stories.summary: Global data centre spending is expected to reach $1 trillion in 2026 and more than double to $2.1 trillion by 2028, driven by rising demand for AI services, BofA Global Research estimates. The data centre market could reach $2.93 trillion by 2030 as AI fuels rapid infrastructure expansion.

stories.headline: ideaForge Technology terminates US joint venture agreement with First Breach
stories.summary: ideaForge Technology has terminated the joint venture agreement between its wholly owned subsidiary, ideaForge Technology Inc., and First Breach Inc. after the deal failed to close before the agreed deadline. The parties have waived all claims against each other, and no shares were issued or capital contributions made under the proposed venture.

stories.headline: Sebi orders Avadhut Sathe Trading Academy to refund ₹546 cr; imposes ₹11.5 cr penalty
stories.summary: The regulator has also barred the academy and Sathe from accessing the securities market for two years or until compliance with the refund direction, whichever is later.

stories.headline: US Treasury yields rise but 10-year stays below 5% as AI jitters persist
stories.summary: US Treasury yields rise after a sharp drop in the previous session, but the benchmark 10 year yield stays below 5% as lingering AI market concerns keep investors cautious. Strong economic activity and sticky inflation remain key factors for bond markets, while expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike next week weaken further.

stories.headline: India’s largest IPO to record investor demand: 10 milestones that made Jio’s IPO a blockbuster
stories.summary: The ₹30,188-crore offering attracted applications worth a cumulative ₹7.4 lakh crore, or around $78 billion, across the anchor and public book-building processes. Here's more.

stories.headline: Lemon Tree Hotels signs 63-room Keys Lite property in Bhilwara, Rajasthan
stories.summary: Lemon Tree Hotels has signed a 63-room Keys Lite property in Bhilwara, Rajasthan, to be managed by its wholly owned subsidiary, Carnation Hotels. Following the addition, the group will have 14 operational hotels and 10 upcoming properties in the state.

stories.headline: EAAA India Alternatives mops up Rs 360 crore from anchor investors; IPO opens on Oct 26
stories.summary: EAAA India Alternatives has successfully raised approximately Rs 360 crore from anchor investors prior to its IPO. This IPO is set to open for public subscription on October 26. The company will not receive any proceeds from the issue as it is an offer for sale. Prominent institutional investors and major domestic mutual fund houses participated in the anchor allocation.

stories.headline: GE Shipping to buy 82,000-cbm gas carrier as fleet expansion gathers pace
stories.summary: The 2015-built vessel is expected to join the fleet in the third quarter of FY27. The company is also buying two bulk carriers and a new-build tanker.

stories.headline: Q2 Results Highlights: Supreme Petro profit up 98%; UTI AMC profit down 34%
stories.summary: Q2 Results Highlights: Infosys, Dr Reddy's Laboratories, JSW Steel, BPCL, IndusInd Bank, Adani Power, Godrej Properties, Jana SFB, Mahindra Logistics, CRISIL, CSB Bank, Coforge, CG Power, Sterlite Tech, Torrent Pharma, Tata Motors CV, UTI AMC, Westlife Developers, Supreme Petrochem, Steel Strip Wheels, Newgen Software, Oracle Financial, were among the companies reporting their numbers today.

stories.headline: ACME Solar commissions additional battery storage capacity of 17.91 MW in Rajasthan
stories.summary: The latest commissioning takes ACME Sigma Urja’s operational battery storage capacity to 71.64 MW, with commercial operations of the new capacity scheduled to begin on October 25.

stories.headline: Highway Infrastructure wins ₹340 crore NHAI contract for Palayam fee plaza in Tamil Nadu
stories.summary: Highway Infrastructure has received a ₹340.08 crore NHAI contract to operate and collect user fees at Palayam Fee Plaza on NH-44 in Tamil Nadu for one year. The contract also covers the maintenance of adjacent toilet blocks and replenishment of consumables.

stories.headline: Shriram Finance Q2 profit jumps 59% YoY to Rs 3,677 crore on strong interest income, lower funding costs
stories.summary: Shriram Finance reported a 59.4% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 standalone profit to Rs 3,677 crore, driven by higher net interest income and lower funding costs. Assets under management grew 17%, while the board declared an interim dividend of Rs 6.50 per share.

stories.headline: Shree Cement profit falls 15% YoY to Rs 263 crore on higher fuel costs
stories.summary: Shree Cement’s September-quarter net profit fell over 15% year-on-year to Rs 263 crore for the third consecutive quarterly decline. Revenue rose 24% and sales volumes increased 14%, but soaring fuel costs pressured profitability despite stronger premium product sales.

stories.headline: Jana Small Finance Bank Q2 profit jumps 127%, raises FY27 growth outlook
stories.summary: Jana Small Finance Bank reported a 127% year-on-year rise in Q2 profit to Rs 170 crore, supported by business growth, higher margins and improved gross asset quality. The bank raised its annual profit growth guidance to 100%, while loans and deposits expanded.

stories.headline: Jindal Steel Q2 profit rises 21% as revenue hits record Rs 19,448 crore
stories.summary: Jindal Steel’s Q2 FY26 profit rose 21% year-on-year to Rs 771 crore, while revenue surged 44% to a record Rs 19,448 crore. Higher steel production and sales boosted earnings, while adjusted EBITDA grew 33% and net debt declined sequentially.

stories.headline: BPCL Q2 Results: Net profit declines 21% YoY to Rs 4,863 crore, revenue grows 29%
stories.summary: BPCL reported a 21.45% year-on-year decline in Q2 FY27 profit to Rs 4,863.05 crore, despite 29.78% revenue growth. Sequential performance rebounded sharply from a quarterly loss, while the company approved a subsidiary for its proposed Andhra Pradesh refinery.

stories.headline: RBI governor reiterates listing requirement for top NBFCs as focus intensifies on Tata Sons
stories.summary: India's central bank governor said on Friday non-bank finance companies classified in the upper layer are required to list on the stock market, reiterating the Reserve Bank of India's stance on the listing of Tata Sons without commenting directly on the company.

stories.headline: Supreme Petrochem Q2 Results: Net profit nearly doubles to ₹95 crore; declares ₹2.50 interim dividend
stories.summary: Supreme Petrochem reported a 97.9% YoY rise in net profit to ₹95 crore for Q2 FY27, while revenue increased 77.8% to ₹1,956 crore. The company also declared an interim dividend of ₹2.50 per share, with October 30 set as the record date.

stories.headline: UTI AMC Q2 results: Net profit falls 34% sequentially to ₹143 crore
stories.summary: Revenue declined 23% quarter-on-quarter, but core income from services grew 5%. Equity schemes attracted net inflows of ₹3,415 crore in the first half of FY27.

stories.headline: Jio IPO breaks 12 records: Rs 4.5 lakh crore bids, highest applications and more
stories.summary: Mukesh Ambani’s Jio Platforms IPO attracted bids exceeding Rs 4.5 lakh crore, setting 12 records, including over 1.25 crore applications. Institutional and retail participation surged, making it India’s largest public offering, with allotment expected October 26 and listing October 28.

stories.headline: FIIs pull out ₹2,697 crore this week; DIIs pump in nearly ₹11,000 crore
stories.summary: Midcap and smallcap stocks fell 6% and 7%, respectively, this week wiping over ₹20 lakh crore off BSE-listed companies’ market value despite sustained domestic institutional buying.

stories.headline: SBI Funds Management Q2 results: Net profit falls sequentially on higher expenses, Revenue rose 3.4%
stories.summary: Revenue edged up 3.4% quarter-on-quarter, while EBITDA margin narrowed to 77% from 80.1% in the previous quarter. Assets under management continued to grow.

stories.headline: Sebi proposes automatic approval route for stock exchanges, depositories to ease compliance burden
stories.summary: The proposal seeks to reduce compliance requirements for market infrastructure institutions (MIIs) and improve ease of doing business. SEBI has invited public comments on the proposed framework until November 12.

stories.headline: Jio Platforms IPO Day 3 Highlights: Total demand hits ₹7.4 lakh crore, highest-ever IPO bids in India
stories.summary: Jio Platforms IPO Day 3 Live Updates: Bidding for Jio Platforms’ ₹30,213-crore IPO is on its final day, with overall subscription crossing 22 times on the NSE as of 7 pm. Jio Platforms’ IPO was fully subscribed within the first 100 minutes on Day 1, making it the fastest mega IPO in India to achieve the milestone. Check the latest on category-wise subscription.

stories.headline: Aditya Birla Real Estate eyes Rs 1,650 cr revenue from new project in Pune
stories.summary: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd has announced plans to develop a housing project in Pune. This initiative will generate an estimated revenue of Rs 1,650 crore through a Joint Development Agreement. The project, located in Hinjewadi, spans 5.62 acres and features a total saleable area of approximately 1.25 million sq ft. Birla Estates, a subsidiary of Aditya Birla Real Estate, will oversee the project development.

stories.headline: Jana Small Finance Bank Q2 results: Net profit more than doubles to ₹170 crore, NIM improves to 7.5%
stories.summary: Net interest income rose 35% year-on-year, while the gross loan portfolio expanded 22%. The bank’s net NPA ratio, however, increased sequentially.

stories.headline: Q2 Results Today Live: JSW Steel posts ₹5,359 cr profit, Adani Power jumps 134%, Infosys up 6.2%; CG Power, CSB Bank gain, Mahindra Logistics turns profitable
stories.summary: Q2 Results Today, 23rd October 2026 Live Updates: Follow the latest announcements and developments on the company's September quarter earning on Adani Power, JSW Steel, Tata Motors, Shriram Fin, Torrent Pharma, CG Power, BPCL, Dr Reddys Lab and others

stories.headline: RBI does not target any specific Rupee level, focuses on curbing volatility, says Governor Sanjay Malhotra
stories.summary: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Governor Sanjay Malhotra on Friday said the central bank does not target any specific exchange rate or level for the rupee against the US dollar, stressing that its primary objective is to ensure orderly conditions in the foreign exchange market and prevent excessive volatility.

stories.headline: US stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq fall amid tech sell-off, Iran tensions
stories.summary: Wall Street opened lower as investors weighed AI spending concerns and rising borrowing costs, while escalating Iran tensions pushed crude oil prices higher.

stories.headline: IndusInd Bank Q2 Results: Lender swings to profit as gross NPA falls to 3%; beats estimates
stories.summary: IndusInd Bank reported a net profit of ₹1,242 crore for Q2 FY27, compared with a loss of ₹437 crore a year ago, beating the CNBC-TV18 poll estimate of ₹1,066 crore. Gross and net NPA ratios declined sequentially, while the bank's provision coverage ratio stood at 70%. Net interest income rose 3.6% year-on-year but fell 2% quarter-on-quarter to ₹4,569 crore.

stories.headline: SBI Cards Q2 profit jumps 75% YoY to Rs 778 crore as bad loan costs fall sharply
stories.summary: SBI Cards reported a 75% year-on-year profit increase to Rs 778 crore in Q2 FY27, driven by lower credit costs and improved asset quality. However, corporate card spending declined, receivables contracted, and net interest margins narrowed.

stories.headline: Jio Platforms IPO ends with demand crossing ₹7 lakh crore - Here are the records it set
stories.summary: Jio Platforms also became the first IPO to receive over 1 crore applications, setting not just an Indian, but a global record. The previous record was also held by an Indian company, Waaree Energies, with 97 lakh applications.

stories.headline: Why US stocks are falling: Dow Jones crashes over 700 points as AI selloff, SpaceX fears hit markets
stories.summary: US stocks experienced a decline as AI related shares continued to selloff significantly over the week. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell markedly, affecting overall investor sentiment in the market. Concerns regarding competition from SpaceX led to drops in major telecom stocks such as AT&T and Verizon. Meanwhile, energy stocks achieved record highs as oil prices rose amid ongoing supply concerns.

stories.headline: Bharat Electronics among 4 Sensex stocks to hit 52-week lows; shares fall up to 9% in a month
stories.summary: Four Sensex stocks, including Bharat Electronics, NTPC, Power Grid Corporation and Hindustan Unilever, touched fresh 52-week lows on Friday as the benchmark index declined. The four stocks have fallen between about 6% and 9% over the past month, reflecting continued weakness in their share prices.

stories.headline: Dr Reddy’s Q2 Results: Net profit falls 36% YoY to Rs 913 crore, revenue declines marginally
stories.summary: Dr Reddy’s Laboratories reported a 36% year-on-year profit decline to Rs 913.4 crore in Q2 FY27, while revenue slipped 1.5%. North America weakness pressured performance, offset partly by growth in India and emerging markets, alongside biosimilar approvals and strategic partnerships.

stories.headline: Only 15% of midcap stocks above 50-DMA: Is buying the dip getting riskier? JM Financial spots signs of leadership shift
stories.summary: JM Financial warns midcap and smallcap leadership may weaken as market breadth deteriorates sharply. Largecaps show early recovery signals, but investors should remain cautious. Nifty holding 22,000 could trigger a rebound; breaking below risks a fall towards 20,500.

stories.headline: Dr Reddy’s Q2 Results: Net profit falls as lower Lenalidomide sales hit revenue; beats estimates
stories.summary: Dr Reddy’s Laboratories reported a 36% YoY decline in Q2 FY27 net profit to ₹913.4 crore, while revenue fell 1.5% to ₹8,671 crore. The company beat CNBC-TV18 poll estimates for net profit, revenue, EBITDA and EBITDA margin, despite year-on-year declines in profitability and operating margin.

stories.headline: Infosys ADR slumps 8% after company lowers FY27 revenue growth outlook
stories.summary: Infosys lowered its FY27 revenue growth forecast amid subdued volumes, pricing pressure and weakness in retail and high-tech. The company maintained its EBIT margin guidance at 20–22%, while Q2 revenue in constant currency terms grew 1.2% sequentially.

stories.headline: Wall Street futures dip after AI rout, telecoms slide
stories.summary: Investors are reassessing the cost of the AI boom just as SpaceX’s reported wireless ambitions threaten to redraw the telecom landscape. With oil prices adding to inflation worries, Wall Street heads into a key Fed week facing multiple sources of uncertainty.

stories.headline: Torrent Pharma Q2 Results: Net profit declines despite 51% revenue growth; misses estimates
stories.summary: Torrent Pharmaceuticals reported a 9.6% YoY decline in Q2 FY27 net profit to ₹534 crore, while revenue grew 50.8% to ₹4,979 crore. EBITDA rose 54.1% to ₹1,583 crore, with the margin improving to 32.33%, although both EBITDA and net profit missed poll estimates.

stories.headline: Bank of India Q2 profit jumps 25% on stronger core income, better asset quality
stories.summary: Bank of India reported a 25.3% year-on-year rise in September-quarter net profit, supported by strong growth in net interest income and operating profit. Asset quality improved, while global business expanded 21.1% to ₹18.93 lakh crore.

stories.headline: Infosys management speaks to CNBC-TV18 after Q2 results: Here are the top takeaways
stories.summary: Infosys CEO Salil Parekh said AI contributed 10.5% of Q2 revenue, while mega deals are expected to add 1% to revenue growth next year. The company lowered its FY27 revenue growth guidance amid softer volumes and pricing pressure, while maintaining its EBIT margin outlook at 20–22%.

stories.headline: US Stock Market Highlights: Dow Jones ends 600 pts lower as AI doubts persist ahead of Fed rate meet
India's 10-year bond falls for 10th week in record slump
stories.summary: Indian government bonds have experienced their worst decline in thirty years, falling consecutively for ten weeks. Rising crude oil prices and a hawkish central bank stance have impacted the market negatively. The benchmark repo rate was recently raised to 5.5%, with further increases expected. The 2036 bond yield rose to 7.4740%, indicating a broader trend of increasing yields. These developments may significantly affect India's import bill and inflation outlook.

stories.headline: Infosys Q2 results Highlights: Infosys cuts FY27 topline guidance, flags pricing pressure; ADR falls
stories.summary: Infosys Q2 Results LIVE Updates: Infosys cut its FY27 revenue growth guidance to 1-2% but retained its margin outlook at 20-22%, as September-quarter revenue broadly met estimates while constant currency growth fell short. Watch this space for all the LIVE Q2 updates from Infosys.

stories.headline: Infosys ADRs crash 6% after Q2 results as revenue guidance cut spooks investors
stories.summary: Infosys ADRs fell 6.3% after the company lowered FY27 revenue growth guidance to 1-2%, despite September-quarter revenue beating estimates. Profit missed expectations, while large deal wins and AI revenue growth offered support amid cautious technology spending.

stories.headline: Market wrap: Eternal, Apollo Hospital, Shriram Finance, Adani Enterprises among top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Friday
stories.summary: Indian equity markets fell for a fourth consecutive session, with the Nifty 50 closing at 22,600 and Sensex at 73,123.83. Small-cap, mid-cap and metal stocks slumped as bearish technical signals heightened concerns about further selling pressure.

stories.headline: Crude surge hammers markets; smallcaps near the brunt
stories.summary: The Nifty 50 closed 0.39% lower at 22,600, after hitting an intraday low of 22,372; Sensex fell 125.56 points to 73,123.83, after trading between 72,452 and 73,766

stories.headline: Jio IPO becomes first public issue globally to cross 1 crore applications; record puts spotlight on depth of India’s retail investor base
stories.summary: Jio Platforms has achieved a remarkable milestone, garnering over one crore applications for its upcoming initial public offering. This surge signifies a burgeoning interest from India's retail investors in technology sectors. With the IPO set to debut on October 28, maintaining this enthusiasm is crucial. The communication strategies employed mirror those found in consumer marketing, urging potential investors to evaluate their financial objectives carefully before engaging with the IPO.

stories.headline: Coforge Q2 Results: EBIT margin guidance raised to 16% as order book jumps 45%; misses estimates
stories.summary: Coforge reported a 13.4% QoQ rise in net profit to ₹588 crore and an 11.6% increase in revenue to ₹6,170.8 crore, with both figures below CNBC-TV18 poll estimates. The company raised its FY27 EBIT margin guidance to 16%, signed a record eight large deals in the quarter and reported a 45% YoY increase in its 12-month executable order book to $2.38 billion.

stories.headline: Broker’s Call: SRF (Buy)
stories.summary: Antique Stock Broking

stories.headline: AI stocks: Midterm elections could threaten AI trade as data center backlash grows
stories.summary: Public opposition to US data centers and the November midterm elections could reshape AI infrastructure investment. Increased regulatory scrutiny, rising electricity costs and construction delays may pressure technology stocks, utilities and power infrastructure companies, despite continued strong AI spending.

stories.headline: European corporate earnings outlook improves as energy profits surge
stories.summary: European corporate earnings growth is forecast to reach 21.9% in the third quarter, driven by soaring energy profits amid US-Iran war volatility. However, inflation risks, elevated oil prices and rising borrowing costs threaten investor confidence and market stability.

stories.headline: Broker’s Call: Mahindra Lifespace Developers (Buy)
stories.summary: ICICI Securities

stories.headline: Infosys dividend alert! IT major announces Rs 26 per share dividend. Check record date
stories.summary: Infosys has declared an interim dividend of Rs 26 per equity share for its shareholders. The record date for this dividend is set for November 3, with payment scheduled for November 11. This announcement follows a final dividend of Rs 25 per share declared in June.

stories.headline: Jyoti Structures wins ₹690 crore Gujarat transmission line order
stories.summary: The 765 kV Pachchham–Saykha project for GETCO is scheduled for completion within 42 months, excluding GST.

stories.headline: Angel One rolls out US stock investing for investors
stories.summary: The company is rolling out the facility in phases, with access currently available to select users

stories.headline: Infosys Q2 Results: FY27 revenue guidance revised to 1% to 2%; Margins projection maintained
stories.summary: Infosys reported constant currency revenue growth of 1.2%, while the street was working with a projection of 1.4% on a sequential basis.

stories.headline: Tata Motors CV Q2 results: Profitability returns on 42% revenue jump; H1 volumes up 35%
stories.summary: Tata Motors’ commercial vehicle business reported a 42% year-on-year revenue jump in Q2 FY27, while net profit more than doubled, beating estimates. Wholesales rose 42%, and strong cash generation pushed the business into a net cash position.

stories.headline: Power stocks have strong order books. Why is Mirae Asset still underweight?
stories.summary: Strong order inflows and healthy near-term prospects are supporting power and industrial companies, but valuations remain a concern for Mirae Asset Mutual Fund. Senior fund manager Ankit Jain flags potential delays in global AI investments and capital expenditure, while a sharp market correction could create fresh investment opportunities.

stories.headline: Sensex today | Stock Market Highlights: Sensex, Nifty extend losses as crude surges to $114, all sectors close in red
stories.summary: Sensex, Nifty, Share Prices Highlights: The domestic stock market continued its downward trend on Friday, with benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty 50 closing in the red amid selling pressure across sectors, rising crude oil prices and weak global cues.

stories.headline: Infosys Q2 Results: Profit rises 6% YoY to Rs 7,823 crore; co lowers revenue guidance
stories.summary: Infosys Q2 Results: IT services major Infosys Ltd on Friday reported 6% year-on-year (YoY) growth in its consolidated net profit at Rs 7,823 crore in the second quarter. The same stood at Rs 7,364 crore in the year-ago period. The company has trimmed its revenue growth guidance to 1-2% in constant currency for FY27 as against 1.5-3% given earlier.

stories.headline: HDFC Securities CEO estimates MTF book could fall to ₹1.4 lakh crore amid market sell-off
stories.summary: HDFC Securities CEO Dhiraj Relli said midcap and smallcap stocks have faced sharp selling pressure, with retail investors and HNIs driving much of the activity.

stories.headline: Paras Healthcare IPO fully subscribed on day 3
stories.summary: The retail investors' category is subscribed 1.80 times, while the portion for qualified institutional buyers receives 1.41 times subscription

stories.headline: IndusInd Bank Q2 Results: Lender posts profit of Rs 1,176 crore vs Rs 445 crore loss a year ago
stories.summary: In the second quarter of this fiscal year, IndusInd Bank reported a standalone net profit of Rs 1,176 crore, showcasing a remarkable turnaround from a loss of Rs 445 crore in the same quarter last year. The bank's net interest income increased by 4% year-on-year to Rs 4,569 crore, driven by enhanced asset quality, while gross non-performing assets decreased to 2.73% of gross advances, indicating robust profitability and growth momentum.

stories.headline: Tata Motors CV Q2 Results: Co swings to black with Rs 1,254 crore profit; revenue jumps 37% YoY
stories.summary: Tata Motors CV Q2 Results: The improvement in profitability was driven by lower mark-to-market losses on investments in Tata Capital Ltd. The company reported a strong net cash position of Rs 15,900 crore as of September 30, 2026.

stories.headline: DCB Bank Q2 Results: Net profit up 28% as gross, net NPAs hit multi-year lows; NII rises 17%
stories.summary: DCB Bank reported a 28.3% YoY increase in net profit to ₹236 crore for the September quarter. Net interest income rose 17.3% to ₹699 crore, while operating profit increased 26% to ₹383 crore. Gross and net NPA ratios improved sequentially to 2.29% and 0.73%, respectively.

stories.headline: Stock Market Highlights: Sensex, Nifty end lower; midcap index slides over 2%, Swiggy plunges 17%
stories.summary: Stock Market Crash Highlights: The Sensex fell 126 points to close at 73,124, while the Nifty 50 declined 88 points to settle at 22,600. Both benchmark indices recovered from their intraday lows but remained in the red.

stories.headline: JSW Steel Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 3-fold on record steel sales, beats estimates
stories.summary: JSW Steel reported a 225.5% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to ₹5,359 crore in Q2 FY27, beating the CNBC-TV18 poll estimate of ₹4,752 crore. Revenue rose 20.7% to ₹54,486 crore, while EBITDA increased 42.2% to ₹10,120 crore.

stories.headline: Rupee little changed this week as oil-fueled declines wipe out early gains
stories.summary: The Indian rupee experienced a decline for the second day in a row as rising oil prices dampened market confidence. Following a brief uptick at the start of trading, the rupee ended lower against the US dollar. Brent crude prices have surged to a five-month peak, raising worries about energy supply interruptions. This led to a pullback from technology stocks as investors flocked towards safer investments like US Treasuries.

stories.headline: Sensex, Nifty end lower as Midcaps tumble; Swiggy suffers biggest single-day fall
stories.summary: The Sensex fell 126 points to 73,124 and the Nifty 50 declined 88 points to 22,600 on Friday while the Midcap index plunged over 2% to 55,801. Selling pressure was broad-based, with the NSE advance-decline ratio at 1:6. Swiggy, Shriram Finance, JSW Steel, ABB and Colgate were among the stocks under pressure.

stories.headline: Adani Power Q2 results: Profit more than doubles to ₹6,919 crore as revenue rises 44%
stories.summary: Higher electricity sales and improved power prices lifted earnings in the September quarter. The company is also expanding thermal capacity and securing long-term power supply agreements.

stories.headline: McDonald’s India operator swings to ₹2.7 crore loss in Q2, but shares sizzle with 9% surge
stories.summary: Westlife Foodworld, which operates McDonald’s restaurants across West and South India, reported higher revenue and operating margins, supported by double-digit growth in customer visits, but swung to a pre-tax loss in the September quarter.

stories.headline: Tariff hikes, market share gains to shape India’s telecom outlook: Arun Kejriwal
stories.summary: Jio Platforms' IPO has set new subscription records, reflecting strong investor interest in India's telecom sector. Market expert Arun Kejriwal says the company's technology, subscriber base and market share gains position it for long-term growth, while measured tariff hikes could support earnings.

stories.headline: KEC International bags ₹1,006 crore in orders, shares hit 52-week low
stories.summary: The RPG Group company won transmission, tower supply and hospital construction contracts, taking its year-to-date order intake to ₹10,600 crore as its shares extend their decline.

stories.headline: Global Market: Eurozone bond markets stabilise after volatile week
stories.summary: Eurozone government bonds stabilised after a volatile week as investors balanced sovereign debt concerns against safe-haven demand amid uncertainty over AI investments and global growth. French borrowing costs remain under pressure ahead of key central bank policy decisions.

stories.headline: Honasa Consumer elevates Vipul Maheshwari to Chief Product & Technology Officer amid AI push
stories.summary: Honasa Consumer Limited shares fell 3.45% to ₹427.15 on the NSE by 1:30 PM, against a previous close of ₹442.40, with sell orders outpacing buy orders

stories.headline: CSB Bank Q2 results: Core income growth 20% from last year; Stable asset quality improves
stories.summary: CSB Bank’s asset quality improved during the quarter. Gross non-performing assets (NPAs) declined to 1.58% as of September 30, 2026, from 1.75% in the previous quarter and 1.81% a year earlier. Net NPAs fell to 0.33% from 0.39% sequentially and 0.52% year-on-year.

stories.headline: SBI Card Q2 results: Net profit rises nearly 75%, total income up 3%
stories.summary: SBI Cards and Payment Services reported a 74.8 percent year-on-year increase in net profit to ₹778 crore for the September quarter, with revenue rising 3.6 percent to ₹5,140.5 crore.

stories.headline: CG Power Q2 Results: Stock recovers from lows after strong order inflow, earnings beat
stories.summary: CG Power's results were a beat against expectations across parameters and the board has also approved capacity expansion plans. The stock though, after the initial recovery, is seeing selling pressure again.

stories.headline: JSW Steel Q2 Results: Net profit rockets 225% YoY to Rs 5,279 crore; revenue rises 21%
stories.summary: JSW Steel Q2 Results: JSW Steel reported a 225% year-on-year jump in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 5,279 crore, while revenue rose 21% to Rs 54,486 crore. EBITDA climbed 39% to Rs 9,941 crore, with crude steel production and steel sales hitting record highs. However, shares fell around 3% after results.

stories.headline: NCDEX eyes equity cash market launch by early 2027, plans ETFs and F&O
stories.summary: Vikas Goel, MD & CEO of NCDEX, said the exchange aims to build a differentiated offering rather than compete directly with established players on their existing strengths. The strategy will focus on multi-factor indices, technology investment and tapping retail investors in smaller towns who remain underserved by financial markets.

stories.headline: Adani Power Q2 Results: Profit zooms 134% YoY to Rs 6,919 crore; revenue jumps 45%
stories.summary: Adani Power has reported an impressive consolidated net profit of Rs 6,919 crore for the second quarter of FY27, which marks a striking 134% increase from last year's profit of Rs 2,953 crore during the same period. Additionally, their operational revenue surged to Rs 19,439 crore, representing a 45% growth from Rs 13,457 crore the previous year.

stories.headline: Gold falls ₹1,000 per 10 grams, silver plunges to 10-month low
stories.summary: Gold and silver prices fell sharply in India ahead of Dhanteras and Diwali, driven by rising crude oil prices, inflation concerns, and expectations of tighter US monetary policy.

stories.headline: CIE Automotive India Q3 profit rises 14% to ₹244 crore as revenue grows 11%
stories.summary: The auto components maker reported stronger sales in India and improved margins in Europe, although higher raw material and energy costs weighed on its domestic margins.

stories.headline: eMudhra exits global SSL certificate business after Google, Apple and Mozilla block certificates
stories.summary: The digital trust firm said the business contributes about 1% of global revenue. It will provide affected customers with replacement certificates at no cost while continuing its other digital signing and security services.

stories.headline: Cyient Q2 Results: Profit rises 22% to ₹133 crore, revenue up 8%
stories.summary: Cyient's Revenue increased 7.7% sequentially to ₹2,235 crore in the September quarter, against ₹2,075.7 crore in the previous quarter. Earnings before interest and tax (EBIT) rose 22.1% year-on-year to ₹228.4 crore. The EBIT margin expanded to 10.22% from 9.01% a year earlier.

stories.headline: Jio Platforms IPO Day 2 Highlights: Issue subscribed 5.19 times, QIB demand crosses 12x
stories.summary: Jio Platforms IPO Day 2 highlights: Jio Platforms’ ₹30,213-crore initial public offering (IPO) was subscribed 5.19 times by the end of the second day of bidding on Thursday, October 22. Qualified institutional buyers (QIBs) subscribed to 12.32 times the shares reserved for their category, while non-institutional investors subscribed 5.50 times their allotted portion. Retail individual investors subscribed to 1.48 times their reserved portion.

stories.headline: Why US stock futures are falling today: Tesla, Meta and 5 key triggers
stories.summary: Big Tech earnings, AI spending concerns, rising oil prices and US economic data are in focus as investors assess Wall Street's outlook and implications for global markets.

stories.headline: UBS acquires 4.8% stake in 360 One WAM in deal valued at over $200 million
stories.summary: The Swiss bank converted 20.5 million warrants into shares, deepening its partnership with the Indian wealth manager after transferring its onshore wealth business to the firm in 2025.

stories.headline: Sensex today | Stock Market Highlights: Sensex sheds 460 pts, Nifty falls 123 pts for 3rd straight session
stories.summary: Sensex, Nifty, Share Prices Highlights: Sensex fell 460 points to 73,249 and Nifty dropped 124 points to 22,687, extending losses to a third straight session

stories.headline: Why Goldman Sachs upgraded equities despite AI concerns and market volatility
stories.summary: Goldman Sachs has upgraded equities to overweight for the next three months, citing cheaper valuations, reduced investor positioning and expectations of strong earnings. Sunil Koul explains why AI stocks remain under pressure despite robust demand, how India could benefit from portfolio diversification, and why elevated oil prices remain a key risk.

stories.headline: Jio Platforms IPO Day 2: Bids cross ₹1 lakh crore; QIB portion crosses 10x subscription
stories.summary: Most brokerages who have covered the IPO, have issued a "subscribe" recommendation. Analysts are anticipating the stock to have a healthy stock market debut when it lists next week.

stories.headline: Nippon AMC pays ₹96.76 crore to settle SEBI case over Yes Bank bonds
stories.summary: Nippon Life India Asset Management has paid ₹96.76 crore to settle a SEBI case over mutual fund investments in Yes Bank’s AT-1 bonds. The regulator’s final settlement order is awaited.

stories.headline: Sensex, Nifty end lower for third day: Elevated crude, weak market breadth weigh on D-Street
stories.summary: Indian equity benchmarks fell for the third consecutive session on Thursday, October 22, with the Sensex declining 460 points to 73,249 and the Nifty slipping 124 points to 22,688, below the 22,700 mark. Elevated crude oil prices, with Brent above $112 per barrel, weak market breadth and continued underperformance in midcaps weighed on sentiment, while the midcap index hit a six-month low.

stories.headline: Stock Market Highlights: Nifty below 22,700, Sensex falls 460 points; auto, FMCG, IT stocks drag
stories.summary: Stock Market Highlights: The markets remained under pressure through the second half of the session, with the Nifty closing below the 22,700 mark at 22,688, down 124 points. Nestle extended its losses, ending 3% lower, while Eternal and Swiggy also declined. The broader market continued to underperform, with the midcap index hitting a six-month low.

stories.headline: What makes the current market sell-off unusual
stories.summary: According to data in DSP Mutual Fund's October 2026 NETRA report, the ongoing market slump stands out not for its severity, but for its unusual mechanics, stark bifurcations, and historical divergences. All the data cited in the article are from the report.

stories.headline: Chennai Petro Q2 Results: Profit doubles, margins expand; GRMs higher than MRPL
stories.summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation's second quarter gross refining margins (GRMs) stood at $20.41 per barrel compared to $8.78 per barrel in the previous quarter and $9.04 per barrel in the year-ago period.

stories.headline: Tata Teleservices narrows Q2 loss to ₹59 crore, revenue up 8%; stock surges 9% on results day
stories.summary: Revenue from operations rose 8.2% year-on-year to ₹309.65 crore; the stock jumped 9.26% to ₹35.03 on the NSE by early afternoon on volumes of over 9.16 crore shares

stories.headline: Brent crude may surge to $120/bbl without geopolitical resolution: ETO Markets
stories.summary: Brent crude could rise to $120 per barrel if geopolitical tensions continue and supply concerns remain unresolved, according to ETO Markets CIO Jonathan Barratt. He expects elevated energy prices to keep inflation under pressure, support further rate hikes and maintain volatility across global markets.

stories.headline: Sapphire Foods shares gain after Q2 loss contracts to ₹1.5 crore, margins expand
stories.summary: Sapphire Foods added 15 KFC restaurants, and one Pizza Hut in Sri Lanka, taking Sapphire Foods' total restaurant count to 1,086 as on September 30, 2026.

stories.headline: Havells India Q2 Results: Revenue growth healthy, margin remains stable
stories.summary: Havells India's Earnings Before Interest, Tax, Depreciation and Amortisation (EBITDA) for the quarter stood at ₹576.3 crore, a growth of 30.6% on a year-on-year basis, and marginally higher than the CNBC-TV18 poll figure of ₹536 crore.

stories.headline: Bond market volatility drags largest sovereign wealth fund to $30 billion loss
stories.summary: Norges Bank Investment Management (NBIM) manages the $2.3 trillion fund. It said accounting return for the period was at a loss of 27.8 billion kroner or $29.7 billion. About 70% of its fixed income portfolio is allocated to the government's bonds while the remaining is invested in corporate debt.

stories.headline: 360 ONE allots 4.8% stake to UBS AG following warrant exercise
stories.summary: UBS AG had subscribed to 20,502,939 warrants on a preferential basis under an agreement with 360 ONE

stories.headline: Here's why SRF shares recovered 8% from the day's low on Thursday
stories.summary: SRF said its two Chemours plants remain on track, with the first expected to be commissioned in the fourth quarter of FY27 and the second in the first quarter of FY28. The company expects the plants to take around 12 months to achieve full ramp-up, with revenue scaling up by FY29.

stories.headline: Sapphire Foods posts best revenue growth in four years, stock slides
stories.summary: The adjusted profit before tax turned positive at ₹120 million against a loss of ₹43 million in Q2 FY26, though reported PBT remained marginally negative at -₹6 million

stories.headline: Nestlé India shares drop 3% amid senior management reshuffle
stories.summary: The stock opened at ₹1,210, touching an intraday low of ₹1,184 — not far from its 52-week low of ₹1,159.40 hit in April 2026

stories.headline: Q2 Results Underperformer: Stock falls 18% in three sessions after profit drops nearly 70%
stories.summary: Jindal Saw reported a 69.03% year-on-year decline in consolidated net profit. The stock has been on a selling spree since its results were announced, declining nearly 18% in the last three sessions.

stories.headline: Largecap stocks may outperform as midcap rally loses steam, says JM Financial
stories.summary: JM Financial expects leadership in Indian equities to shift from midcap and smallcap stocks to largecaps as technical indicators improve. Rahul Sharma says the Nifty holding above 22,000 could trigger a rally towards 24,000, while cautioning investors against increasing exposure to broader market stocks amid weakening momentum.

stories.headline: NCDEX forays into equity markets with launch of two new indices
stories.summary: NCDEX has launched two equity indices, NDEX and FINNDEX, marking its strategic expansion beyond commodity derivatives into the equity segment.

stories.headline: Amagi Media shares slip after company flags cybersecurity threat
stories.summary: Amagi Media has launched an investigation with external cybersecurity experts and legal counsel after a threat actor threatened to publish allegedly obtained operational data unless a payment was made.

stories.headline: Sagility's Chirok Health Acquisition can boost its stock price by 31%, JPMorgan says
stories.summary: The acquisition should add 0.6% and 1% to Sagility's FY27 and FY28 revenues, respectively, and JPMorgan estimates the transaction to be margin accretive as well.

stories.headline: IMF's Krishna Srinivasan says India should prioritise inflation as crude oil price risks rise
stories.summary: The IMF has warned that prolonged high crude oil prices remain a downside risk for Asia and India. Krishna Srinivasan said India's central bank should focus on inflation rather than the rupee, while calling for reforms to attract stronger foreign direct investment.

stories.headline: eMudhra shares crash 20% to 52-week low after govt orders security probe
stories.summary: On the NSE, the stock tumbled 19.91% to ₹346 apiece; the scrip of the company tanked 19.63% to ₹346.85 per share on the BSE

stories.headline: UBS acquires 4.8% stake in India's 360 ONE WAM after warrant conversion
stories.summary: UBS boosted its stake in India’s 360 ONE WAM by about 4.8% after converting warrants and paying the exercise price, expanding its wealth management tie-up

stories.headline: Fusion CX shares list at 5.5% premium over IPO price on NSE
stories.summary: The stock debuted at ₹292, marking a 1.04% premium on the BSE, while it opened at ₹305 apiece, up by 5.54% on the NSE

stories.headline: Indian Hotels shares hit 52-week high after strong Q2 results and upgraded revenue outlook
stories.summary: Indian Hotels is targeting 50 openings in all of FY27. It is looking at opening over 30 hotels in the second half of the fiscal.

stories.headline: Retail portion of Jio Platforms' IPO fully subscribed
stories.summary: By 11:00 am, the retail individual investors category got fully subscribed.

stories.headline: HDFC Bank shares near 52-week low amid insider leak probe
stories.summary: Veteran ICICI Group executive Anup Bagchi is set to assume the role of chief executive on October 27, inheriting a bank navigating multiple leadership upheavals simultaneously

stories.headline: Balkrishna Industries shares rise on proposed 50:50 Pirelli JV for passenger car tyres
stories.summary: The proposed joint venture will set up and operate a new manufacturing plant in India, subject to certain conditions. The two companies plan to execute the joint venture agreement in the future, with incorporation targeted by December 31, 2030.

stories.headline: Stock Crash: eMudhra shares down 34% in three sessions; Management says 'one-off incident on a bad day'
stories.summary: Shares of eMudhra declined 14.6% to hit an intraday low of ₹368.75 apiece on Thursday after falling 20% in the previous session. In the last three sessions, it has fallen 33.7%.

stories.headline: Tesla-SpaceX mega-merger may boost Elon Musk’s fortune by $110 billion
stories.summary: SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to explore a potential merger, a move that could significantly boost Elon Musk's fortune and accelerate his share vesting.

stories.headline: Indian IT stocks could gain 30-40% over the next 2–2.5 years, says Sandip Agarwal
stories.summary: Sandip Agarwal, Fund Manager at Sowilo Investment Managers, expects profit after tax (PAT) to grow by 45–70% across Indian IT companies over the next three years, depending on the company. He believes earnings growth will be a key driver of returns during this period.

stories.headline: Nifty has bottomed at 22,000 but 150 overvalued midcaps face capitulation, says Quant's Sandeep Tandon
stories.summary: Investors should use the current market weakness to rebuild exposure in large caps, particularly focusing on relatively high-beta names, Tandon said. He highlighted asset-heavy companies, utilities, power, pharmaceuticals, and telecom which remain strong themes.

stories.headline: Persistent Systems shares decline after it launches QIP to raise up to ₹4,265 crore
stories.summary: In June 2026, Persistent Systems had announced the acquisition of Nagarro SE with a total outlay of $1.45 billion. The initial bridge is now refinanced via a combination of rupees debt sales and QIP.

stories.headline: eMudhra data breach: MarketSmith's Mayuresh Joshi takes wait-and-watch approach
stories.summary: Mayuresh Joshi also explains why cybersecurity spending is set to rise after recent data breaches and shares his latest view on market rotation, highlighting sectors showing earnings strength amid volatility.

stories.headline: MarketSmith sees ARPU gains and broadband growth lifting Jio, Bharti Airtel earnings
stories.summary: According to Mayuresh Joshi, Director of Research at MarketSmith India, Jio Platforms is well positioned to benefit from rising telecom tariffs, broadband expansion and its digital initiatives.

stories.headline: PC Jeweller jumps 8% on rise in Q2 profit and debt-free status
stories.summary: The company posted a more ‌than 50% jump in quarterly profit and ‌said it had fully ⁠repaid debt owed ‌to a 14-bank consortium.

stories.headline: 'Sell these defence stocks' is the word from Goldman Sachs - Three key reasons behind the bearish call
stories.summary: Shares of Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders and Garden Reach Shipbuilders have corrected between 35% to 42% from their respective 52-week highs, and Goldman Sachs sees further downside on these stocks.

stories.headline: Jio Platforms IPO Day 1 Highlights: Jio Platforms IPO Day 1 Live: Issue subscribed 1.27x, QIB portion 3.86x
stories.summary: Jio Platforms IPO GMP Day 1 Highlights:: Jio Platforms IPO Jio Platforms’ ₹30,213-crore IPO opens for subscription on October 21 and closes on October 23.

stories.headline: Vedanta Aluminium shares can jump 40%; Nomura recommends buying its peer as well
stories.summary: Nomura believes Vedanta Aluminium is undergoing a favourable reset in its cost structure, which could support value creation. For Hindalco, the brokerage sees potential in expansion projects that it believes the market has yet to fully recognise.

stories.headline: NSE shares fall after equity worth ₹3,225 crore free up for trade today as one-month lock-in ends
stories.summary: NSE made its stock market debut last month, listing at a 0.8% premium to its issue price of ₹1,785 per share and went on to gain as much as 4%. The stock currently trades below its issue price.

stories.headline: Eternal's growth to stay 'higher for longer', but Blinkit margins face small-town test: Bernstein
stories.summary: Bernstein's Jignanshu Gor unpacks the latest quarterly numbers from Eternal, highlighting a shift in the quick-commerce narrative, peaking food delivery margins and the structural challenges facing Vishal Mega Mart.

stories.headline: Rupee flat against dollar after 8-session winning streak: Why crude oil remains a risk
stories.summary: The Indian rupee opened flat at 94.47 against the US dollar, after rising for eight straight sessions. The rally is driven by RBI measures, Jio Platforms IPO flows, and dollar unwinding, though rising

stories.headline: M&M Financial shares fall 9% after Q2 results, even as analysts see further upside
stories.summary: Of the 38 analysts who have coverage on the M&M Financial Services stock, 28 have a "buy" rating, eight have a "hold" rating and two have a "sell" rating.

stories.headline: Oil prices could ease despite Strait of Hormuz risks; AI investment theme remains intact: Julius Baer
stories.summary: Bank Julius Baer's Mark Matthews expects crude oil prices to soften despite tensions around the Strait of Hormuz, saying history shows geopolitical oil shocks rarely last long. He also believes the AI investment theme remains intact, driven by earnings and productivity gains, and expects India's technology sector to adapt and benefit from AI over time.

stories.headline: Eternal share price can rise 35% after Q2 results, Motilal Oswal says; Check other price targets
stories.summary: Bernstein sees upside risks to the Eternal's financial year 2026-2029 Net Order Value Compounded Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) guidance of over 60%, while Motilal Oswal is projecting a 35% upside for the stock.

stories.headline: Chinese stock market in 'bear territory' after 20% fall from June peak
stories.summary: China mainland shares near a technical bear market as the CSI 300 Index drops 20 percent from its June high, driven by weak stimulus hopes, poor earnings, and global AI jitters.

stories.headline: Meta Q3 revenue rises 26%, aims for up to $76 billion in Q4
stories.summary: Advertising remained the main driver of growth, with revenue from ads rising 26% year-on-year to $63.06 billion. Ad impressions across Meta's family of apps increased 10%, while the average price per ad rose 14%.

stories.headline: Gold, silver slide in global markets: What is weighing on prices
stories.summary: Gold and silver prices declined globally and in India as West Asia tensions raised crude oil prices and inflation concerns, while the rupee strengthened.
